expected.title: Q3 results
expected.summary: Q3 revenue was $4.2M, up 18% from Q2, and churn fell from 3.1% to 2.4%. The mobile app launched on schedule and four engineers were hired. Support response time missed its target and two support agents will be added in October.
key_points: Support response time 9 hours against a 6 hour target
Two support agents to be added in October
